clean_repro.observed: Returns HTTP 200 with scored points from source collection instead of error. API ignores invalid lookup_from.collection and returns results from query collection.

contract_refs: constraint_id: structured_contract.json line 1260-1264 defines lookup_from as 'Cross-collection lookup location' - implies collection must exist
constraint_id: API contract suggests cross-collection lookup requires valid target collection

source_grounding.source_excerpt: // lib/collection/src/operations/universal_query/collection_query.rs defines lookup_from: Option<LookupLocation>. Source code does not show explicit validation that lookup_from.collection exists before attempting cross-collection vector lookup. This is a validation gap - nonexistent collection should return 4xx error instead of being silently ignored.
source_grounding.call_chain_traced: POST /collections/{c}/points/query with lookup_from -> convert_query_request_from_rest -> query execution -> no collection existence check before lookup
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现: lookup_from.collection存在性校验缺失。API应验证目标collection存在，否则返回4xx错误，而非静默忽略并使用源collection的向量。

falsification.observed: When lookup_from.collection='test_lookup_target' (existing collection), API correctly performs cross-collection lookup. The bug is that nonexistent collection is silently ignored instead of returning error.

cognition_match.developer_quote: Parameter validation on filter/condition APIs (min_should, value_count). Missing lookup_from.collection validation falls into this blindspot - maintainers may not have considered nonexistent collection case.
cognition_match.note: 命中开发者盲点：lookup_from.collection存在性校验缺失

verdicts.rationale: POST /collections/{c}/points/query with lookup_from.collection='nonexistent_collection_xyz' should return 4xx error but returns 200 with results from source collection. Contract暗示cross-collection lookup需要有效的target collection，但源码未验证collection存在性。这是parameter validation bug，违反API contract中'Cross-collection lookup location'的隐含要求。API应返回404或类似的collection不存在错误，而非静默忽略无效lookup_from。
